scope: Actual canonical graded pieces of the frozen first literal Joux–Vitse homogeneous F101 source ideal I in P=F101[x,y,h]. Proves I is homogeneous for Mathlib standard grading. DegreeMap is the actual quotient map P→P/I restricted to Mathlib degree-d homogeneous submodule; its kernel is exactly I intersected with that domain. Canonical piece P_d/ker(DegreeMap) is linearly equivalent to its actual image; image equals span of precisely matching-degree vectors of the previously proved actual quotient basis, derived from checked actual multiplication tables and monomial/homogeneous induction. Exact canonical degree-piece dimensions1,3,3,1,0 thereafter, zero iff d≥4; total scalar dimension/length8 retained and direct graded-dimension-versus-total-dimension inequality. No ideal-homogeneity/basis/Hilbert/GB/regularity/native-output conclusion is supplied as a premise; unchanged old actual-object proof reused. Closes the finite canonical per-degree identification, not generic JV Assumption2, FGHR genericity/n≥3, internalF4 degree/refinement, whole-curve order/scalar relations or a general graded-module Hilbert polynomial theory.
